Meditative #49.3 AI Girlfriend (`meditative-049-3`, a token, printed Mythic) is printed today as a **Field Spell** with the **Animated** keyword (§6.1, R383, MD-C25): YileGPT Prime's Cry summons it into the backrow and it animates into a unit zone as it enters, or stays a backrow card whose forced attacks find no target (R1025).
